name: Quebec
note: Province-wide open layers: GAGQ hunting zones, TRQ parks/ZECs/outfitters, StatsCan 2021 CSD municipalities. Quebec does not publish an open Crown tenure parcel fabric, so the green layer shows managed hunting territories rather than public land ownership. No policy documents are bundled; consult official Quebec sources.

layers.label: Managed hunting territories
layers.coverage: ZECs, exclusive hunting territories, outfitter exclusive areas (TRQ)
layers.note: Managed territories with their own access rules and fees — not a Crown tenure fabric and not open public access.
